# Lulu Kids — Juegos educativos tranquilos para niños (2 a 8+ años) / Calm Learning Games for Kids

> App bilingüe (español e inglés) de juegos educativos, cuentos ilustrados y actividades sin internet para niños de 2 a 8+ años. Gratis con anuncios (se quitan con un código tras donar), sin cuentas ni compras, disponible en Google Play.

Sitio web: https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/ (Español) · https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/en/ (English)
Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.lulukids.kids_app

## Parent Guides in English (20)
- [Animals for kids: vocabulary and curiosity](https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/en/blog/animales-vocabulario-curiosidad.html): How to use children's natural interest in animals to widen vocabulary, observe, ask questions and learn to care for living things.
- [Safe apps for kids: a parent checklist](https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/en/blog/apps-seguras-ninos-checklist.html): What to check before installing a kids' app: ads, permissions, purchases, external links, data and parental controls, with a practical checklist.
- [Learning to lose: frustration in games](https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/en/blog/aprender-a-perder-frustracion-juegos.html): Why children find it hard to lose or make mistakes, how to respond in the moment and which habits help games become a safe place to fail.
- [Learning letters without pressure](https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/en/blog/aprender-letras-sin-presion.html): How to support a child aged 2 to 7 in recognizing letters and sounds with games, stories and simple routines, without forcing reading.
- [Stories about feelings for kids](https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/en/blog/cuentos-emociones-ninos.html): How to use stories to help kids aged 2 to 8 name their emotions, from anger to sadness, with simple questions and routines.
- [Drawing and painting: nurture creativity](https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/en/blog/dibujar-y-pintar-creatividad.html): What to expect from children's drawing by age, which materials to offer and how to comment on a child's work without always saying "how pretty".
- [Teach colors and shapes without flashcards](https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/en/blog/ensenar-colores-y-formas.html): Practical ideas for a 2 to 5 year old to learn colors and shapes by playing at home, at the park and on screen, with no pressure or boring drilling.
- [Logic games for kids: patterns and sequences](https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/en/blog/juegos-de-logica-pensamiento.html): How to introduce logical thinking to kids aged 3 to 8 with patterns, sorting and sequences, at home and on screen, without making it boring.
- [Memory games for kids](https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/en/blog/juegos-de-memoria-concentracion.html): Matching, observation and recall games for kids aged 3 to 8, with tips to avoid frustration and build concentration gradually.
- [Educational games by age (2 to 8+)](https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/en/blog/juegos-educativos-por-edad.html): Parent guide: what to look for in an educational game at ages 2, 4, 6 and 8+, signs of a good game and when to change level.
- [Offline play for trips and waiting rooms](https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/en/blog/jugar-sin-internet-viajes.html): Offline game ideas, with and without screens, for the car, plane and waiting rooms, and why it helps not to depend on internet.
- [Bilingual kids in Spanish and English](https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/en/blog/ninos-bilingues-espanol-ingles.html): How to support a child learning Spanish and English together: one-person-one-language, routines, books and games, and what to do if they mix languages.
- [Screen-free family games](https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/en/blog/juegos-en-familia-sin-pantallas.html): Simple screen-free games for family play with kids aged 2 to 8: no materials, household items and tabletop games, adapted to each age.
- [Reading aloud to kids](https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/en/blog/leer-en-voz-alta-ninos.html): How to read aloud to kids aged 2 to 8: choosing books by age, asking questions that spark conversation and what to do when they will not sit still.
- [Music and rhythm for kids](https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/en/blog/musica-ritmo-ninos-piano.html): Simple music ideas for kids aged 2 to 8: homemade instruments, rhythm and echo games, volume care and how to use a piano app without pressure.
- [Kids' endless "why" questions](https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/en/blog/preguntas-por-que-curiosidad-ninos.html): What to do with the constant "why" questions of kids aged 2 to 8: short, true answers, what to say when you do not know and games to feed curiosity.
- [A calm bedtime routine for kids](https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/en/blog/rutina-para-dormir-ninos.html): A five-step night routine for young kids: warnings, a story, a fixed goodbye, and what to do about screens, fears and days that go off plan.
- [First numbers: teach counting through play](https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/en/blog/primeros-numeros-contar-jugando.html): How to go from reciting numbers to understanding quantities: everyday games, typical counting mistakes and tips by age for kids 2 to 7.
- [Puzzles for kids: benefits and ages](https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/en/blog/rompecabezas-beneficios-ninos.html): What children learn from puzzles, how many pieces to choose by age and how to help without solving it for them.
- [Screen time for young kids: a calm routine](https://lulu-kids-page.vercel.app/en/blog/tiempo-de-pantalla-rutina.html): A practical four-step routine for young kids' screen time, with general WHO guidance and tips for handling limits.
